session.description: Revocable SCS session; store token in the OS keychain

get.description: WebSocket upgrade for ASR; stream protocol remains owned by the AI worker.

delete.description: Erase worker conversation and memories; requires reset_id UUID query. Idempotent.

parameters.description: Monotonic version returned by the account conversation reset.
parameters.name: reset_version

delete.description: Clear worker context. Account archive has its own clear endpoint.

post.description: SSE reply/audio events. Existing worker request schema; account identity is supplied by this gateway.
SSE audio replay for an existing worker message.

Translate owned assistant or user text, or an exact owned suggestion, to zh-Hans, zh-Hant or en, preserving ids/kinds/order. source_kind defaults to assistant; suggestion requires option_id. Read-only, owner-scoped and cached; does not alter context or audio.
Register an already-played bundled first meeting. No paid model invocation.
Cancel preparation for this session lease; retains completed, unexpired drafts.

Prepare one real AI draft per eligible gesture, idle or entry scenario. preparation_scope=entry warms only the upcoming introduction/return; active warms the current role. Unused drafts are not conversation history.
Read-only availability for the current context; does not start generation.
Generate three ranked user replies to source_message_id, then prepare one answer per option in rank order. Nothing is published until the exact option is chosen with quick_reply_id.
Read the ranked choices for the latest AI turn. No paid generation.

get.description: Private worker readiness; does not invoke a paid provider.

post.description: Read-only owner-scoped configuration inspection. Development/test opt-in, or explicitly provisioned developer accounts in production with worker opt-in for the same account. Other production accounts receive 404. Never invokes a paid provider.
